risk_if_not_implemented: Without Quantum Threat Intelligence Monitoring, security events may go undetected, allowing threats to persist and increasing breach dwell time.

compensating_control_1.name: Threat Intelligence Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to implement a threat intelligence program that includes a cross-organization information-sharing capability that can influence the development of the system and security architectures, selection of security solutions, monitoring, threat hunting, response and recovery activities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Threat Intelligence Program (THR-01) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Quantum Threat Intelligence Monitoring (QTS-05.1) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Threat Intelligence Feeds
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain situational awareness of vulnerabilities and evolving threats by leveraging the knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures to facilitate the implementation of preventative and compensating controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Threat Intelligence Feeds (THR-03) provides threat intelligence and situational awareness that compensates for the absence of Quantum Threat Intelligence Monitoring (QTS-05.1) by providing early warning of threats and informing proactive security posture adjustments. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
